comments.author: remember0764
comments.body_html: Can the mod work together with the Live Flea Price?

comments.author: ZloyMolodoy
comments.body_html:
Hello.

Not recommended to run both at the same time - they write to the same price table and will overwrite each other. UltimateFlea with “priceSource”: “tarkovdev” already pulls live Tarkov.dev averages. If you only want prices without the economy simulation, set “enableEconomy”: false in mod.json. If you want PVE prices, set “pvePrices”: true in mod.json.

comments.author: ZloyMolodoy
comments.body_html:
hello

Yeah, you can run it fully local - set “priceSource”: “local” in mod.json. Prices come from local data, no internet needed.

Tarkov.dev isn’t required. In tarkovdev mode, prices from the site are saved after a successful fetch. If the site is down later, it uses those saved prices; if it never managed to download them before, it uses local prices instead.

As a DrakiaXYZ replacement - yes, if you want flea pool control, pricing, and supply/demand sim. Not a 1:1 clone, but it covers local market emulation fine. Not dumb questions at all.

comments.author: ZloyMolodoy
comments.body_html:
Hi

There are two different blacklists here:

UltimateFlea’s own rules (pool.json, blacklist mode) - items you remove from the flea. SPT / other-mod bans - items already blocked for live realism (or by mods like WTT). UltimateFlea only restores those if you explicitly list them in add / addCategories. If you just want the mod to leave the pool alone - set “enablePoolManager”: false, or keep empty lists in pool.json. Nothing gets banned or unbanned.

If you want to bring back SPT/mod-banned items - keep pool manager on and add them in add / addCategories. Turning pool manager off won’t unban them.

More details on the config options are in the mod description.
